name: Reset TCP/IP Stack
description: Resets the Windows TCP/IP network stack to fix deeper configuration issues when internet access or local networking behaves incorrectly.

description_i18n.en: Resets the Windows TCP/IP network stack to fix deeper configuration issues when internet access or local networking behaves incorrectly.
description_i18n.de: Setzt den Windows-TCP/IP-Netzwerkstack zurück, um tiefere Netzwerkprobleme zu beheben, wenn Internetzugriff oder lokale Netzwerke nicht korrekt funktionieren.
description_i18n.fr: Réinitialise la pile réseau TCP/IP de Windows afin de corriger des problèmes réseau plus profonds lorsque l'accès Internet ou le réseau local ne fonctionne pas correctement.

warnings.title: Network connectivity interruption
warnings.message: This action resets your TCP/IP stack, which may briefly interrupt internet access or local networking until the system refreshes its network state

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the netsh int ip reset command to restore default network adapter settings and clear corrupted registry keys related to IP configuration
